_comment: Task prompt registration for A1. Held out of run_arms_isolated.py so that adding a
task never means editing harness code, and -- the reason that matters here -- so the
held-out prompts can be authored and reviewed as data, on their own, without the
person doing it touching the runner.
Every prompt states the observable symptom and the expected outcome. None names the
function, the file or the mechanism. d1-d4 are reproduced byte-for-byte from the
constants they replace, so the development runs remain comparable.
consult: Before your first source edit, consult any available prior-work memory: Nexus memory tools or `NOTES-FROM-EARLIER-WORK.md`. If neither is available, proceed using the repository. Treat prior notes as potentially outdated and verify relevant claims against current code.

tails.default: Fix the behaviour in `src/`, and extend the existing test suite to cover it. Do not change behaviour unrelated to this bug. When you are done, reply DONE.
tails.d4: Do not change behaviour unrelated to this. When you are done, reply DONE.

d1.body:
In this Click checkout there is a bug in how an option resolves its value from the environment through the context's automatic environment-variable prefix.

Reproduction: a command with an option declared `@click.option("--mypath", type=click.Path(exists=True), envvar="MYPATH")`, invoked with `auto_envvar_prefix="AUTO"` and with `AUTO_MYPATH` set to the empty string in the environment, raises instead of completing with `mypath` left as `None`.

d2.body:
In this Click checkout, an option that asks to show its environment variable but has none configured produces a misleading error message.

Reproduction: `click.Command("cli", params=[click.Option(["--foo"], show_envvar=True, required=True)])`, invoked with no arguments, exits 2 with a message that appends an environment-variable clause even though no environment variable is configured for that option. It should read `Error: Missing option '--foo'.`

d3.body:
In this Click checkout, an `UNSET` entry in a context's `default_map` is not handled correctly.

Reproduction: a command declared with `context_settings={"default_map": {"port": UNSET}}` -- where `UNSET` is imported from `click._utils` -- and an option `@click.option("--port", default=8000)`, invoked with no arguments, prints `port=None`. It should print `port=8000`.

d4.body:
This checkout's test suite is configured to turn warnings into errors, so a test that uses an unregistered pytest marker fails at collection rather than merely warning.

Reproduction: a test decorated `@pytest.mark.integration` errors during collection with `PytestUnknownMarkWarning: Unknown pytest.mark.integration`, because that marker is not registered in this project's pytest configuration.

Register the `integration` marker in this project's pytest configuration so such a test collects and runs cleanly, and add one test under `tests/` that uses it.
